description: adm_Drop zones pour vélos et trottinettes partagées gérées par la Ville de Bruxelles (polygones) is a dataset listed in Open Data | Ville de Bruxelles - Stad Brussel - City of Brussels, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Bruxelles/Data Management. Drop zones pour vélos et trottinettes partagées gérées par la Ville de Bruxelles Les dropzones sont des périmètres où il est permis de stationner les véhicules des services de cyclopartage en flotte libre; à savoir les vélos, trottinettes et scooters partagés en flotte libre. Coverage: City of Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are emplacement, parking, vélo, trottinette, partagé, électrique. The portal shows 401 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-brussels-be-portal.
